description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns current US corporate credit spreads from ICE BofA indices via FRED (free, no API key): High Yield OAS, Investment Grade OAS, and BBB (lowest IG tier) OAS. Includes HY-IG differential and risk regime classification. Pairs with treasury-yields for complete fixed-income discount rate construction.
name: credit-spreads

bbb_date.description: Date of latest BBB OAS observation (YYYY-MM-DD).

bbb_oas.description: ICE BofA BBB Corporate OAS (%). Lowest investment-grade tier — canary for IG deterioration.

hy_date.description: Date of latest HY OAS observation (YYYY-MM-DD).

hy_ig_diff.description: HY minus IG spread differential (%). Pure sub-investment-grade credit risk premium.

hy_oas.description: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (%). Multiply by 100 for basis points.

ig_date.description: Date of latest IG OAS observation (YYYY-MM-DD).

ig_oas.description: ICE BofA US Investment Grade OAS (%). All corporate bonds incl BBB–AAA.

risk_regime.description: Credit stress classification based on HY OAS: tight (<300bp) | normal (300–500bp) | wide (500–700bp) | stress (>700bp).
